data.desc: Scorpio Tankers Inc. is a provider of marine transportation of petroleum products worldwide. Scorpio Tankers Inc. currently owns 74 product tankers (25 LR2 tankers, 35 MR tankers and 14 Handymax tankers) with an average age of 10.3 years. The Company has reached agreements to sell two LR2 product tankers, which are expected to close in the fourth quarter of 2026. The Company has also reached agreements to construct five MR newbuildings with deliveries expected in 2027 and 2030, eight LR2 newbuildings with deliveries expected in 2027 and 2029 and four VLCC newbuildings with deliveries expected in 2028.
